description: The person's key and the company's key on chain, read from one salted passkey bundle (receipts/ck-salted.bundle.json: receipts/a1v1.bundle.json with a top-level citizenKeySalt and its issuer delegation naming the readable Base Sepolia registry). Verify with resolver = receipts/did-documents.json, rpcUrl https://rpc.test, chainId 84532 and no registryAddress, and the clock pinned at `now` (unix seconds). citizenKeySalt, when present, replaces the bundle's field (null removes it). rpc false: no rpcUrl at all. Every eth_call is answered by its selector from `answers`: registry(bytes32) 0x7ef50298 by registry[ref], keyOf(bytes32) 0xdf78bce2 by keyOf, companyKeyOf(bytes32,bytes32) 0x25597a89 by companyKeyOf, getCompanyDid(bytes32) 0x8181c629 by getCompanyDid, and eth_getLogs by anchorBatchLogs; an answer absent is a JSON-RPC error. expect.citizenKey is the web verifier's own reading (chainState, colour, reason); the other keys are result fields; companyKeyVerdict is result.companyKey.verdict and companyKeyRotated result.companyKey.rotated; `absent` lists result fields that must not be present.

cases.name: a key in force at grantedAt reads green
a key never recorded, now one second before G + LAG, is pending and neutral
a key never recorded, now at G + LAG, reads notRecorded and withholds
a voided key record withholds the key and leaves the root untrusted
a key not yet valid at grantedAt is refused
a key retired before grantedAt is refused
a key recorded more than LAG after grantedAt is amber but does not withhold
a keyOf read that fails is unreachable and neutral
a keyOf answer that does not decode is unreadable and withholds
a malformed salt is unreadable and withholds, with no keyOf read
a salt absent on a registry that serves keyOf reads notLinked and withholds
a salt absent without an rpcUrl changes nothing
a salted bundle without an rpcUrl reads no key
a consent anchored more than SKEW before grantedAt is refused, and so is the company key's date
a consent anchored more than LAG after grantedAt reads consentRecordedLate and withholds
a company key retired before grantedAt is refused
a company key with no window on its domain is pending and not confirmed
a voided company key is refused
a companyKeyOf read that fails leaves the company key unconfirmed
a company that has since rotated its key still verifies, and says so
